title: Automated security testing inside the project

videos.script: Every lesson so far ended with a test that says what the application must refuse. Those tests are already security checks. {{tests}} They know this application. They do not know what is risky in any Python program. {{gap}} A static checker does. It reads the code without running it, and points at the call that is known to be dangerous. {{bandit}} Some of what it says is noise. You answer the noise on purpose, one finding at a time. {{noise}} Then you put the tests, the checker and the dependency audit behind one command. And you make git run it before every commit. {{hook}} Today you watch a commit be refused, fix four findings, and watch it go through. {{today}}
